Frostmark Shop: dome with the red-and-gold striped awning left of the plaza

094.why: Recovery Bay curved counter in front of the healing pods

095.why: L-shaped shop counter on the left

104.why: Ingrid Vale at the top of Aurora Tower 2F, below the sealed stairs

t: Frostmark Research Station. The crystal in this fountain was cut from the glacier and never melts.
Founded by survey crews who came for the aurora and stayed for the ice.
Aurora Route. West: Frostmark. East: Crystal Caverns.
Warning: frost grass hides wild Alienmon. Keep a Stasis Pod handy.
The crystal wall looks almost like a wing... something huge is folded up inside the ice.
A scratched note: 'Fossil Dig is just above. Mind the stairs.'
Frozen fossil site #1. A jawbone longer than a shuttle, gouged by teeth from something even bigger.
The bite marks are ringed with frost that never thaws.
Frozen fossil site #2. Ribs snapped clean through. The tooth marks are as wide as a road.
Field tag: 'Predator unknown. Size: impossible.'
Frozen fossil site #3. A thighbone with one huge crescent bite taken out of it.
Three sites, one bite pattern. Whatever ate these was the size of a moon.
The Teeth in the Ice: a giant Ystran creature, frozen mid-roar in the glacier wall.
Dig crews say it hums when the aurora is bright.
Frozen Falls. The water froze mid-plunge, all at once, in a single night.
Locals swear a Glaciryx nests behind the ice curtain.
Aurora Relay Crystal. It pulses in time with the sky.
Plaque: 'Keeper Ingrid Vale awaits challengers on the floor above.'
Researcher: Something huge is frozen inside the glacier wall past the caverns.
We call it the Teeth in the Ice. Nobody sleeps well near it.
Climber: Ice paths are slick. Jump the cracks, don't walk them.
Aurora Route has frost grass. Wild Alienmon love it.
Radio tech: Our antennas pick up signals from the Starfall Rift.
Lately they pulse in sync with the aurora. Spooky, right?
Townsfolk: The Recovery Bay is the dome with the cyan cross. Heal before the caverns!
Guard: Helix crews keep asking for dig permits. The station keeps saying no.
If you see anyone in a Helix strand-suit near the fossils, tell us.
Wanderer: Keeper Ingrid lives up in Aurora Tower, past the Frozen Falls.
Win a Signal Shard from her and you'll have really earned it.
Mom: My kids want to catch a Cryo-type. I said only after their homework thaws.

094.name: Nurse
t: Nurse: Welcome to the Frostmark Recovery Bay. Let's warm your team right up.
Climber: Cold doesn't bother Cryo-types, but everyone else hates the caverns.
Heal here before you head out. It's a long walk back.

095.name: Clerk
t: Clerk: Stasis Pods, gels, warm socks. Okay, not socks. Take a look!
Researcher: I buy Stasis Pods by the crate. Cave Alienmon break out a lot.
Climber: Trainers spot you from a few tiles away. Step out of their line if your team is hurt.
Researcher: The aurora isn't just pretty. It carries a signal. We just can't read it yet.
Radio tech: The Crystal Caverns are ahead. Three floors deep, then up into the Fossil Dig.
Wanderer: Fire melts ice, they say. Bring something hot for Ingrid's team.
Miner: These crystals sing when you tap them. Don't. The wild ones hear it too.
Researcher: My Alienmon fainted in the cold once. Always carry a Revive Spark down here.
Climber: The stairs above lead to the Fossil Dig. Look closely at those bite marks.
Dig chief: Three fossil sites, same bite pattern every time. Read the markers.
Digger: I asked Helix for better drills. They asked where the biggest bones were.
I didn't tell them.
Pilgrim: The falls froze the night the aurora turned violet. I come here to listen.
Climber: Aurora Tower is just east. Ingrid trains Cryo-types up top.
Relay tech: This tower boosts the aurora signal across the whole system.
Ingrid's apprentices will test you on the way up.
Researcher: Ingrid reads ice cores like books. She says the ice remembers the Devourer.

notes: Glacia (08). The Aurora Tower fountains (103, 104) sit in the central corridor; the player walks round them on the ring (cols 6 and 9), which slightly overlaps a lamp and the void edge. On 101 the left exit path runs along a thin snow band at the top edge of a frozen pool (row 7). Quest M12 places the three fossil sites 'in the crystal caverns'; per the lead they are sign objects on Fossil Dig (101), plus one for the giant skeleton pit.
